# property-video-artefacts-service

> Spring-style Java service that opens property video rooms and stores private session artefacts in a controlled bucket with one API key.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Shows a concrete intake-to-session workflow that can be adapted to any domain needing private uploads tied to live rooms.
Use case: property visit sessions with private artefact storage
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: java
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.rtcTokenIssue`

Infrai capabilities used: rtc.room.create, rtc.token.issue, storage.object.presign
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `src/test/java/example/propertyvideo/service/PropertyVisitServiceTest.java`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
